note: The board-v2 films as data, from design/board-v2/films/. Durations are targets for drawing; the server's deadlines are the only clock. Not a rule and not an adopted contract.

audience.lighting: public: every phone and the display, every normal round, whether or not anyone asked for a strike
audience.strip: public: the same strip, the same size and brightness, on every phone (not the display)
audience.selection: owner-private: the eligible Disabler's own phone, in their bound room only
audience.outcome: public: the round's published batch (authorized hits only; a miss shows nothing anywhere)

films.clock: Milliseconds from the window's opening: previewEndsAt - 5000. Drawn from the trusted previewEndsAt and endsAt, never from a local start time.
notInputs: a role, a cause or a defense

beats.what: Numbered position markers fade in at every fixed slot of every room, empty ones included
Lights on: figures, name tags and markers
Two dips of every room's light (4300-4420, 4650-4770) and each room's own light sparking at 4700, which light seeded by the window id
Every room goes to its dark drawing; figures and name tags fade and leave the page; markers turn dark; captions to 70%; the shared strip comes up
Static dark. The eligible Disabler selects in their bound room, from previewEndsAt to endsAt
Dark until the outcome is published
At each authorized hit: the flash, the star, its rays; the hit room's art shakes 3 px for 160 ms. Nothing at a miss
Every room comes back together; people in their published state
Markers fade out; the board is normal

reduced.what: No flicker, sparks, shake or travel. 80 ms fades: markers in at 0; one fade to the static dark at 4920 with a still spark in each caption; one fade back at R; a still burst on each hit position for 600 ms

flashLimit.note: Counted over every second of the film; a flash's area is its bright part (a dip covers the board, which is why there are only two)

layers.L1: figures (hidden in the dark, not on the page)
layers.L3: each room's dark drawing over its art, clipped to the panel; sparks; impacts; markers
layers.L6: press areas: never moved, never shaken
layers.L9: the strip over the Command band (public; the selection line private)
layers.L10: top bar and navigation: never dimmed
